title: Mickie James’ Last Rodeo
summary: Mickie James stakes her career on every match while attempting one more climb to the championship. The winning streak culminates in a title-versus-career showdown with Jordynne Grace.

chapters.title: One more loss means retirement
chapters.context: She commits to earning another title shot from the bottom and says that her next defeat will end her in-ring career.

chapters.title: Mickie survives Mia Yim
chapters.result: James defeats Yim to keep the Last Rodeo alive.
chapters.context: An established opponent raises the difficulty of the climb. The victory keeps the career stipulation in play as Mickie approaches the champion.

chapters.title: Career saved, championship won
chapters.result: Mickie defeats Jordynne Grace for the Knockouts title.
chapters.context: James wins the title-versus-career main event, completing the Last Rodeo’s climb and avoiding the retirement condition.
